create_tempdir_decorator: create a decorator that provides a temporary directory to test methods and cleans it up after execution
test_tempdir_decorator: test the tempdir decorator by applying it to a TestCase method that writes files to the injected temp directory
refactor_tempdir_decorator: refactor the tempdir decorator to support async test methods that need temporary directory access
review_tempdir_decorator: review the tempdir decorator to verify it properly wraps TestCase methods with temporary directory cleanup
summarize_tempdir_decorator: summarize the tempdir decorator which injects a TemporaryDirectory path as the first argument to test methods
